evidence.label: Pipeline fee
evidence.value: 0.25% of each swap's input, charged by the router on every hop and paid to Pipeline's treasury.
evidence.source: Pipeline docs/INTEGRATOR-GUIDE.md; constant text kept by Aviary

evidence.label: Router protections on swaps
evidence.value: The router moves your input into the strategy's vault, refuses the swap if you would receive less than your minimum, and never takes more than the amount you signed. You do not sign the call to the strategy, so it can pay you but cannot take from your accounts.

evidence.label: Custom actions
evidence.value: Any strategy instruction other than a swap is signed directly on the strategy; the router's protections and fee do not apply to it.

evidence.label: Bypass
evidence.value: A strategy may allow trades that skip the router; those pay no Pipeline fee and leave no swap event.

evidence.label: Vetting
evidence.value: Pipeline does not vet strategies; anyone can register one.

evidence.label: Router control on devnet
evidence.value: The router is upgradeable. Its upgrade authority 2yJJsmhvs2SBsKVtiKCG4wBJNoTH67aRNMhSwkupvUHZ is also its admin, who can pause swaps, market creation and registration.
evidence.source: Router ProgramData 3dpKiLED... and Config BmdeX3kW... read 2026-11-09 at slot 520324283

summary.text: The key 2yJJ...vUHZ can replace this strategy's code at any time, and this is its fourth version since 2026-11-07.
In the market sampled here, the token takes a 1% fee on every transfer, which its creator can change, on top of Pipeline's 0.25% fee.
Canary's first probe on 2026-11-09 saw a tiny buy sold straight back return 99.39% of the input.

claims.text: Besides Pipeline's 5 required instructions and its optional seeding one, the program has one more, called deposit.
deposit appears to let anyone add tokens to a market, and no instruction appears to take them back out.
Across its 20 markets, 26 swaps have gone through Pipeline, from 7 wallets.
The key 2yJJ...vUHZ can replace the program's code at any time, for every market at once.
It has upgraded the program 3 times; since the last upgrade on 2026-11-08, 2 of the 20 markets cannot be quoted or traded.
The same key is the router's upgrade authority and admin, who can pause swaps.
In the sampled market, the token's creator B1dQ...jiZE can still mint more of it and change its 1% transfer fee; nobody can freeze token accounts.
On 2026-11-09, 0.00001 SOL sold straight back returned 99.39% of the input, before Pipeline's fee and the token's transfer fee.
A call to the strategy's swap that skipped the router was refused, so its swaps cannot avoid the router.
When you trade through Pipeline, the router refuses the swap if you would get less than your minimum, and never takes more than you signed.
deposit is signed directly on the strategy, so the router does not protect it.
Its author has published no description: the metadata link returns an error.

unknowns.text: There is no verified source, so how it prices trades is known only from its probes.
Whether a sale works at larger sizes, after time passes, or after the authorities act: the full exit test has not run.
